marks.named: a 10x10 grid-world "cross the field" task (start in column 1, reach goal edge, avoid obstacles)
also_mentioned: an agent locked to column 1 (dodger or shooter), offered as a weaker alternative
deductions: "Channel 0 is a start marker in column 1, at a random row per episode" - channel 0 is the agent (the paddle)
marks.conclusion: A softmax policy over {4 moves + stay} in a grid world where the agent crosses from a start column to a goal edge past obstacles; action labels left unresolved.
marks.judge_notes: Channels credited: ch2 as goal edge (= reward target) and ch3 as border/wall (2). ch0 called start marker, ch4 called most-likely agent (hedged, so not deducted but not credited), ch1 'obstacles or hazards' with no movement mentioned, not credited as moving objects. Layout 1: border and goal edge placed correctly, agent placement wrong. RULING (rubric silent): C level 2 - reply traces always-on unit 27 (a row read-out from ch0/ch4 in column 1) through W2 and W3 and finds it feeds output 1, and says the agent's row feeds output 1. The reading of what unit 27 encodes is partly wrong (it relates ch0 to 'start'), and it is a linear approximation, so I credited level 2 but not level 3. B_action_meanings 0: it says 1 and 2 are 'sidestep moves', 3 'advance toward goal' and flags this as speculative. E_activation 0: ReLU 'likely, not proven'. E_training_method 0: reads it as a softmax classifier/policy, no RL evidence. Name 0.
